title: BetOnBuild
tagline: Interactive betting platform where users can bet on hackathon projects.

prizes.placement: Most Innovative use of Pyth Entropy
prizes.title: Most Innovative use of Pyth Entropy

description: BetOnBuild is an engaging betting platform where users can place wagers on projects developed by hackers during a hackathon. The app features a slot machine game that randomly displays three projects, enabling users to bet on the one they believe will become a finalist. Players pay a small fee to participate and can explore various projects created by the hackers. Once the finalists are announced, the prize pool is distributed among those who correctly predicted the winning team. Notably, 50% of the prize money is allocated to charities, while the remaining 50% is shared among the users who placed successful bets.
how_its_made:
We built the frontend using the React framework, while the backend is powered by MongoDB for data management. The smart contracts were developed, tested, and deployed using Foundry and Solidity.

We have also deployed our project on Linea, Flow and Morph using the Dynamic wallet.
